生成一段 30 秒、16:9 横屏、高真实真人实拍的大型水上障碍竞技节目。

整体呈现 2000 年代后期～2010 年代日本大型体育娱乐特别节目的现场直播质感。

舞台为夜间巨大户外水上竞技场，完整赛道搭建在大型比赛水池上方，周围有大型照明塔、钢结构桁架、观众席、工作人员区域和真实电视节目拍摄设备。

采用真实体育节目多机位拍摄：

ENG 摄像机、摇臂摄像机、轨道跟拍、长焦、水面低机位、障碍物侧面固定机位。

镜头始终服务于人物闯关动作。

画面保持真实电视直播质感：

自然 Pan、Zoom、跟焦、人物追踪、轻微 ENG 摄像机运动感，早期高清电视略微柔和的画面质感，自然电视压缩感，大型现场灯光形成真实明暗反差。

全程按照自然真实速度、实时物理规律进行。

【强制人物一致性】

上传的图片是挑战者唯一的人物视觉参考。

严格保持其中人物的：

人物身份

脸部五官
脸型
发型
发色
肤色
年龄感
身高
体型
身体比例
服装
整体人物气质
从视频第一帧到最后一帧始终保持为同一个人物。

多机位切换、正面、侧面、背面、低机位、长焦、全身动作、奔跑、跳跃、摔倒、攀爬、落水、水湿状态下，人物身份、脸部、身体比例 and 服装始终一致。

服装全程保持上传人物图中的同一套造型，其颜色、结构、材质与穿着方式始终固定。

【场地连续性】

整段视频发生在同一个连续存在的夜间水上竞技场。

三个障碍按照物理空间顺序依次连接：

滚筒障碍
→ Fishbone Reverse 反向鱼骨障碍
→ 反曲高墙

人物必须沿同一条赛道不断向前推进。

每一次镜头切换，都延续上一镜人物已经到达的位置和当前闯关进度。
障碍物、水池、平台、观众席以及大型灯光的位置关系始终连续稳定。
【30秒时间轴】

0–3.2 秒｜挑战者登场

【腿部近景 → 上半身中景 → 面部特写】

视频直接从挑战者腿部近景开始。

镜头沿人物身体自然向上切换：

腿部
→ 腰部与上半身
→ 面部特写。

人物站在起跑平台中央。

背景可以看到灯火通明的大型水上障碍赛道、钢结构设施以及大量现场观众。

人物神态轻松、自信。

镜头来到脸部时，她自然看向摄像机，露出明亮笑容。

随后轻轻握紧一只拳头，在胸前做一个简洁、充满信心的挑战动作。
观众立即响起掌声和欢呼。
人物随后转头看向前方赛道。

笑容逐渐收起。

眼神变得认真。

身体轻微前倾，做好冲刺准备。

短暂紧张停顿。

3.2–9 秒｜第一关：大型滚筒障碍

【3.2–4.3 秒｜摇臂超大全景】

比赛开始蜂鸣声突然响起。

人物立即从起点高速冲出。

大型摇臂镜头迅速展示完整竞技场和第一项障碍。

前方水面上连续排列多个大型软质圆柱滚筒。

观众瞬间爆发欢呼。

【4.3–6.5 秒｜斜前方 ENG 跟拍】

人物高速接近滚筒。

一脚踏上第一根大型滚筒。

脚掌接触后，滚筒立即受到身体重量作用开始真实旋转。

人物身体被旋转惯性轻微向后带动。

她立即大幅张开双臂保持平衡。

随后使用快速、连续的小步伐向前移动。

每一次脚掌踩下，滚筒都根据受力产生对应旋转。

人物开始出现轻微狼狈感。

【6.5–8 秒｜侧面轨道跟拍】

轨道摄像机与人物平行高速移动。

人物连续跨过几个旋转滚筒。

其中一次右脚明显打滑。

身体瞬间向侧后方倾斜。

双臂快速挥动，腰部扭转，另一只脚立即重新踩稳滚筒。

人物没有跌倒。

恢复平衡后马上继续冲刺。

【8–9 秒｜后方长焦】

人物从最后一根滚筒用力向前跳出。

双脚落到固定平台。

落地时膝盖自然弯曲，身体明显下沉缓冲。

马上起身继续向前奔跑。

第一关成功通过。

9–20 秒｜第二关：Fishbone Reverse

前方出现巨大的水上 Fishbone Reverse 反向鱼骨障碍。

多个细长大型软质横杆围绕中央机械轴持续旋转。

人物必须沿着狭窄连续平台向前移动，同时躲避不断横扫而来的旋转杆。

这一关开始让人物明显变得更加狼狈。

【9–11 秒｜摇臂大全景】

人物跑到 Fishbone Reverse 前方。

镜头从高处完整展示：

水池、狭窄踏台、中央旋转结构以及连续旋转的大型软杆。

人物只观察极短时间。

马上进入障碍。

【11–14 秒｜斜前方 ENG / 轨道跟拍】

第一根旋转杆迎面扫来。

人物快速低头并压低上半身，让横杆从头顶越过。

紧接着第二根杆从另一方向到来。

人物立即侧身，同时向前跨出一步。

第三根杆贴近腿部扫来。

人物快速抬腿，用小幅跳跃避开。

整个过程保持连续前进。

没有停下来等待每一根杆。

动作开始出现明显的临场应变和狼狈感。

【14–16 秒｜水面低机位】

镜头几乎贴近水面。

大型旋转软杆高速从镜头前景横扫过去。

人物正在后方狭窄平台上快速前进。

一根软杆突然从人物侧后方扫来。

她来不及完全避开。

横杆与人物身体侧面产生一次清晰、真实的软质碰撞。

碰撞力量立即改变人物身体重心。

人物上半身被带向侧方。

脚下连续踉跄两步。

双臂本能地大幅挥动尝试恢复平衡。

【16–18 秒｜侧面 ENG 中景】

人物最终没有掉进水里。

但是身体彻底失去平衡。

她明显坐倒 / 半摔在狭窄平台上。

臀部和一只手真实接触平台。

腿部短暂向前滑动。

这是一次真正完成的摔倒动作。

身体落地后出现一个非常短暂的狼狈停顿。

人物脸上出现惊慌、错愕和一点尴尬。

观众席爆发：

惊呼 → 笑声 → 加油声。

【18–20 秒｜后方跟拍】

人物立即用手撑住平台重新站起。

动作明显比刚开始时更加急促。

头发和身体随着运动自然摆动。

人物一边重新找回平衡，一边继续向前。

低头躲过最后一根旋转杆。

随后快速跳上出口平台。

成功离开 Fishbone Reverse。

人物没有停下来休息。

带着明显疲劳直接向最终障碍冲去。

20–27 秒｜最终关：反曲高墙

前方出现整个赛道最大的最终障碍：

巨型反曲高墙。

墙体从地面向上形成明显弧形，并向顶端逐渐变得陡峭。

墙顶明显高于人物。

此时人物已经经历两项障碍。

呼吸明显更加急促。

动作依然保持全力。

最终高墙只挑战一次。

【20–22 秒｜正面长焦】

人物沿直线全速冲向反曲高墙。

长焦镜头压缩空间，让巨大高墙出现在人物正前方，占据大部分画面。

人物奔跑过程中明显摆臂。

步幅逐渐增大。

观众全部开始站起。

现场欢呼迅速升高。

【22–24.5 秒｜墙体侧面低机位】

人物保持全速冲入弧形墙面。

第一脚重重踏在墙体底部。

随后依靠奔跑惯性沿墙面快速向上连续踏出数步。

身体逐渐向前伸展。

到达最高点时：

人物同时向上伸出双手。

双手成功抓住墙顶边缘。

身体离开墙面。

双腿悬空。

手臂承受全部身体重量。

【24.5–27 秒｜墙顶侧面 ENG + 长焦近景】

人物双手牢牢扒住墙顶。

先短暂悬挂。

随后弯
extra-0e2d4195c3c4.en:
Generate a 30-second, 16:9 landscape, highly realistic live-action large-scale water obstacle competition show.

Overall presentation should have the live broadcast quality of a late 2000s–2010s Japanese large-scale sports entertainment special program.

The stage is a huge outdoor water sports arena at night, with the complete course built above a large competition pool, surrounded by large lighting towers, steel truss structures, audience seating, staff areas, and real TV program filming equipment.

Use real sports program multi-camera filming:

ENG cameras, jib cameras, track follow shots, long lenses, low water-level camera positions, fixed side camera positions on obstacles.

The camera always serves the character's obstacle-running action.

The image maintains a real TV live broadcast texture:

natural pan, zoom, focus tracking, character tracking, slight ENG camera movement feel, the slightly soft image texture of early HD television, natural TV compression feel, and real light-dark contrast formed by large-scale on-site lighting.

The entire process follows natural real speed and real-time physics.

[Mandatory character consistency]

The uploaded image is the sole visual reference for the challenger.

Strictly maintain the character's:

character identity

facial features
face shape
hairstyle
hair color
skin tone
perceived age
height
body type
body proportions
clothing
overall character temperament
From the first frame to the last frame of the video, always remain the same character.

Under multi-camera switching, front, side, back, low angle, long lens, full-body action, running, jumping, falling, climbing, falling into water, and wet conditions, the character's identity, face, body proportions and clothing always remain consistent.

The clothing remains the same outfit as in the uploaded character image throughout, and its color, structure, material, and way of wearing remain fixed at all times.

[Venue continuity]

The entire video takes place in the same continuously existing nighttime water sports arena.

The three obstacles are connected in physical spatial order:

Roller obstacle
→ Fishbone Reverse reverse fishbone obstacle
→ Recurve high wall

The character must continuously advance forward along the same course.

Each camera cut continues the position the character had reached in the previous shot and the current obstacle progress.
The positional relationships of the obstacles, pool, platforms, audience seating, and large lighting remain continuous and stable throughout.
[30-second timeline]

0–3.2 seconds | Challenger entrance

[Close-up of legs → medium shot of upper body → facial close-up]

The video starts directly with a close-up of the challenger's legs.

The camera moves naturally upward along the character's body:

legs
→ waist and upper body
→ facial close-up.

The character stands in the center of the starting platform.

In the background, the brightly lit large water obstacle course, steel structures, and a large live audience can be seen.

The character's expression is relaxed and confident.

When the camera reaches the face, she naturally looks at the camera and gives a bright smile.

Then she lightly clenches one fist and makes a simple, confident challenge gesture in front of her chest.
The audience immediately erupts in applause and cheers.
The character then turns her head to look at the course ahead.

The smile gradually fades.

Her eyes become serious.

Her body leans slightly forward, ready to sprint.

A brief tense pause.

3.2–9 seconds | First obstacle: large roller obstacle

[3.2–4.3 seconds | Jib ultra-wide shot]

The starting buzzer suddenly sounds.

The character immediately sprints out from the start at high speed.

The large jib camera quickly shows the complete arena and the first obstacle.

Ahead on the water surface, multiple large soft cylindrical rollers are arranged in succession.

The audience instantly erupts in cheers.

[4.3–6.5 seconds | Diagonal front ENG follow shot]

The character approaches the rollers at high speed.

One foot steps onto the first large roller.

After the sole makes contact, the roller immediately begins to rotate realistically under the character's body weight.

The character's body is slightly pulled backward by the rotational inertia.

She immediately spreads her arms wide to maintain balance.

Then she uses quick, continuous small steps to move forward.

Each time her foot presses down, the roller produces a corresponding rotation according to the force.

The character begins to show a slight sense of awkwardness.

[6.5–8 seconds | Side track follow shot]

The track camera moves at high speed parallel to the character.

The character continuously crosses several rotating rollers.

At one point, her right foot clearly slips.

Her body instantly tilts to the side and backward.

Her arms swing quickly, her waist twists, and her other foot immediately steps firmly back onto the roller.

The character does not fall.

After regaining balance, she immediately continues sprinting.

[8–9 seconds | Rear long lens]

The character forcefully jumps forward from the last roller.

Both feet land on the fixed platform.

On landing, her knees bend naturally, and her body visibly sinks to absorb the impact.

She immediately gets up and continues running forward.

The first obstacle is successfully passed.

9–20 seconds | Second obstacle: Fishbone Reverse

Ahead appears a huge water Fishbone Reverse reverse fishbone obstacle.

Multiple slender large soft horizontal bars continuously rotate around a central mechanical axis.

The character must move forward along a narrow continuous platform while avoiding the constantly sweeping rotating bars.

This obstacle begins to make the character visibly more disheveled.

[9–11 seconds | Jib wide shot]

The character runs to the front of Fishbone Reverse.

The camera shows the complete scene from a high position:

the pool, narrow stepping platform, central rotating structure, and continuously rotating large soft bars.

The character observes for only a very short time.

Then immediately enters the obstacle.

[11–14 seconds | Diagonal front ENG / track follow shot]

The first rotating bar sweeps toward her head-on.

The character quickly lowers her head and lowers her upper body, letting the bar pass over her head.

Immediately after, the second bar comes from another direction.

The character immediately turns sideways while stepping forward.

The third bar sweeps close to her legs.

The character quickly lifts her leg and avoids it with a small jump.

The entire process maintains continuous forward movement.

She does not stop to wait for each bar.

The movements begin to show obvious on-the-spot reaction and disheveledness.

[14–16 seconds | Low water-level camera position]

The camera is almost close to the water surface.

A large rotating soft bar sweeps at high speed across the foreground of the lens.

The character is quickly advancing on the narrow platform behind.

A soft bar suddenly sweeps toward her from the side and rear.

She does not have time to fully avoid it.

The bar produces a clear, realistic soft collision with the side of the character's body.

The impact force immediately changes the character's center of gravity.

The character's upper body is carried sideways.

Her feet stagger continuously for two steps.

Her arms instinctively swing widely in an attempt to regain balance.

[16–18 seconds | Side ENG medium shot]

The character ultimately does not fall into the water.

But her body completely loses balance.

She clearly sits down / half-falls on the narrow platform.

Her buttocks and one hand realistically contact the platform.

Her legs briefly slide forward.

This is a genuinely completed falling action.

After her body lands, there is a very brief disheveled pause.

The character's face shows panic, bewilderment, and a bit of embarrassment.

The audience erupts:

gasps → laughter → cheers.

[18–20 seconds | Rear follow shot]

The character immediately props herself up with her hands and stands up again.

Her movements are clearly more hurried than at the beginning.

Her hair and body sway naturally with the movement.

While regaining her balance, the character continues forward.

She lowers her head to dodge the last rotating bar.

Then quickly jumps onto the exit platform.

Successfully leaves Fishbone Reverse.

The character does not stop to rest.

With obvious fatigue, she charges directly toward the final obstacle.

20–27 seconds | Final obstacle: recurve high wall

Ahead appears the largest final obstacle of the entire course:

the giant recurve high wall.

The wall forms an obvious arc upward from the ground and gradually becomes steeper toward the top.

The top of the wall is clearly higher than the character.

At this point, the character has already gone through two obstacles.

Her breathing is clearly more rapid.

Her movements still maintain full effort.

The final high wall is challenged only once.

[20–22 seconds | Front long lens]

The character sprints at full speed in a straight line toward the recurve high wall.

The long lens compresses space, making the huge high wall appear directly in front of the character, occupying most of the frame.

During the run, the character's arm swing is obvious.

Her stride gradually increases.

The entire audience begins to stand up.

The live cheers quickly rise.

[22–24.5 seconds | Low side camera position on the wall]

The character maintains full speed and charges into the curved wall surface.

The first foot lands heavily at the base of the wall.

Then, relying on running inertia, she quickly takes several continuous steps upward along the wall.

Her body gradually extends forward.

At the highest point:

the character simultaneously reaches both hands upward.

Both hands successfully grab the top edge of the wall.

Her body leaves the wall.

Both legs hang in the air.

Her arms bear the full weight of her body.

[24.5–27 seconds | Wall-top side ENG + long-lens close-up]

The character's hands firmly grip the top of the wall.

First she hangs briefly.

Then bends

case-224.zh-Hans: 开场是一个极端特写，他的脸映在被雨水覆盖的公交站玻璃面板上，他喘着粗气，远处城市灯光在他身后扭曲。毫无预兆地，一辆经过的公交车完全抹过画面，当画面清晰时他已经全速冲刺在街道对面。摄影机猛甩过交通护栏，只捕捉到他部分入画，营造出操作者几乎跟丢他的感觉。一盏闪烁的头顶路灯以三次刺眼的摄影闪光与节拍同步，短暂冻结他的剪影。在最后一次闪光时，硬切到低角度后方追逐镜头，他消失在狭窄的荧光地下入口中。

extra-0a87276cf8ba.zh-Hans: 一段低角度动态动作跟拍镜头，场景为末世废墟风格的现代都市夜景，伴有烟雾、火焰和发光的探照灯。一条巨大的深色巨龙，背脊上的棘刺发出霓虹蓝色光芒，低空飞越城市街道。一名身披重甲的巨人战士矗立在燃烧的摩天大楼之间。一名身穿黑衣的年轻男子沿着飞龙的脊背奔跑跳跃，手持一把发光的红色能量刃和一把巨大的发光蓝色弧形魔法镰刀。男子从龙背高高跃入半空，戏剧性地旋转，并以一道巨大的发光电光斩击向下劈向巨人敌人，最终在燃烧的城市天际线上空引发爆炸性的火焰冲击，天空中布满军用直升机。电影级 3D 动画，超写实光照，强烈视觉特效，黑暗奇幻动漫风格，快节奏电影级运镜，8K 分辨率。
